drawing_inputs: All inputs necessary for offline redraw are in data/. Original training arrays/model checkpoints are not needed for redraw.
interpretation: Pearson correlations use pairwise nonmissing raw values across 15,351 genes. Each selected column has |r| >= 0.8 with at least one top-30 feature. This is descriptive analysis rather than held-out prediction accuracy. Clustering uses average linkage, Euclidean distance and optimal ordering.
